Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de utilaje industriale, Vânzări angro de feronerie, instalații, echipamente de încălzire și Tehnologie, informații și mass-media
Adecco Permanent Placement is recruiting on behalf of one of its clients, a leading international group in thermal comfort solutions, for a Cyber Defence Lead .
 What you will do
Define and execute the Group ICT Cyber Defence strategy and roadmap
Lead security operations, threat detection and incident response activities
Drive the continuous improvement of preventive, detective and responsive security controls
Govern vulnerability management and cyber threat intelligence processes
Coordinate the response to major cybersecurity incidents and improve recovery capabilities
Monitor cybersecurity KPIs, operational metrics and risk indicators
Manage security vendors, MSSPs and external service providers
Partner with senior stakeholders to strengthen the Group's cyber resilience
 What we are looking for
8+ years of experience in Cyber Security, with strong exposure to Security Operations and Cyber Defence
Experience leading cybersecurity teams and managing external security providers
Hands-on knowledge of SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, Vulnerability Management and Threat Intelligence solutions
Solid understanding of Incident Response and Security Operations processes
Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks such as NIST and ISO 27001
CISSP, CISM, GIAC or similar certifications are considered a plus
Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills
Fluent English
 What the company offers
Opportunity to lead and shape Cyber Defence capabilities at Group level
Exposure to a complex international environment
Strategic role with high visibility across the business
Competitive compensation package
 If you apply for this role, please upload your CV on the Adecco platform. Adecco needs your GDPR consent to process your personal data in order to include you in the recruitment process.
